title: avena preslii
intro: Avena preslii, commonly known as oat grass, is a perennial grass that belongs to the Avena genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its ability to soothe the gastrointestinal tract. Avena preslii's therapeutic actions include its anxiolytic and sedative properties, making it useful for stress relief and promoting better sleep. The bioactive constituents of Avena preslii include avenanthramides, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
